page.notes: The signature "D ʃ" at the foot is read as "D s" (the figure 5 printed in a long-s-like form); the number may be a 5 and is doubtful. The paragraph continues beyond this page. Printed forms such as "qvi", "qvem", "qvorum" and "in qva" are kept as printed. The ligature in "factum" is transcribed as "ct". A dot-like smudge at the left edge is dust and is omitted.
